headline: Multiple Asia-Pacific markets lift limits on active ETF holdings; single-stock ETFs may be launched locally in future
summary: Several Asia-Pacific regulators have lifted caps on the share of individual stocks that ETFs may hold. Singapore's Monetary Authority is revising its rules, which could allow local single-stock ETFs.
why: Exchange-traded funds are listed funds that hold baskets of assets, and rule changes on their holdings affect how investors access equities.
